ds.name: Gmarket Sans
ds.description: Gmarket's SIL OFL brand typeface — 3 weights, TTF/OTF, 11,172 KR glyphs. First-party font artifact from a 25-year-old open marketplace; backing 247 :root CSS vars + Smile Yellow #ffd200 + Club/Event/Service sub-systems on the storefront.
